title: DM admission host handover (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17), option A (SEP2-6 / IMP2-8): when the admission host's user is no longer a DM member (left, offboarded), a remaining member PUTs the current member list to its own identity host, then commits a GroupContextExtensions proposal setting agora_admission_host to that host, which issues and registers a new admission key; clients MUST do this automatically; the old host may stop serving after a stated period.
